places.name: Kenya
places.title: Kenya — Living systems, wildlife and ecological context | 4PLANET
places.description: Explore Kenya as a living system: forests, grasslands, drylands, wetlands, coastal and marine ecosystems, protected areas, pressures, sources and an ATLAS map.
places.summary: Kenya spans multiple ecological zones and habitats, including lowland and mountain forests, wooded and open grasslands, semi-arid scrubland, dry woodlands, inland aquatic systems, wetlands, and coastal and marine ecosystems.
places.truthBoundary: This page is a source-grounded country-scale discovery object. The ATLAS bounding box is a navigation extent, not an official administrative or ecological boundary. Protected-area totals and coverage figures use different source definitions and must not be collapsed.
places.protectedAreasSummary: Protected Planet's September 2026 country profile lists 374 protected areas. Kenya Wildlife Service separately states that its national parks, national reserves and national sanctuaries cover 8.2% of Kenya's land mass. These are different measures with different coverage and definitions.
